project_type: npm workspaces monorepo (shared/, backend/, frontend/, infra/). Issue #18 is a FRONTEND-only change plus docs. Frontend is a React 18 + react-router-dom 6 SPA built with Vite, strict TypeScript, ESM.
build_system: npm workspaces. Root build is ordered shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra via `npm run build`. node/npm may NOT be on PATH; prefix with PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" (verified present, npm 11.4.2, node v22.23.3).
test_framework: Vitest (unit/component, jsdom via @testing-library/react) run with `npm test` (vitest run) per workspace. Playwright e2e in frontend/e2e/*.spec.ts run with `npm run test:e2e -w frontend` (headless chromium; config starts the vite preview server). Component tests use render() with providers; see frontend/src/components/*.test.tsx and frontend/src/App.test.tsx.
verification_instructions: 1) `npm run build` (ordered shared->backend->frontend->infra) must pass. 2) `npm test` (all workspace vitest suites) must pass. 3) `npm run test:e2e -w frontend` (Playwright headless chromium; may need `npx playwright install chromium` once) must pass. 4) `npm run synth` (frontend build + cdk synth, no AWS calls) must pass as a regression guard. Do NOT run cdk deploy. Do NOT make live Bedrock/MLB calls.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in that need regeneration for this change. Playwright writes screenshots to frontend/test-results/ (gitignored artifacts).
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed (node_modules present, baseline `npm run build` passes). If Playwright chromium is missing, run `npx playwright install chromium` once (requires network). Stay on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site; make incremental commits per the steering (.kiro/steering/*.md is inclusion:always).
environment_constraints: node/npm not on default PATH (use the nvm bin prefix above). Playwright chromium must run --no-sandbox (config already handles headless). No live network to Bedrock/MLB; e2e stubs the API via page.route (see frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts). Do NOT push/PR/deploy - the orchestrator owns GitHub publishing and AWS redeploy.
contribution_requirements: Steering (.kiro/steering/kiro-university.md, product.md, tech.md, structure.md, testing.md) is inclusion:always and is GRADED. Spec-driven dev is graded: update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements.md,design.md,tasks.md} to describe the system as actually built. Keep README.md AND README.ja.md truthful (both document each shipped feature; see the 'Dark mode and accessibility' / 'ダークモードとアクセシビリティ' sections added for #22 as the pattern). Make incremental local commits; conventional-commit style with issue scope e.g. `feat(issue-18): ...` (see git log).
key_patterns: PERSISTED LOCALIZED CONTROL pattern already established twice: (a) i18n language (localStorage key `mlb.lang`, frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: readStoredLang/storeLang guarded, I18nProvider context, LanguageToggle component) and (b) theme (localStorage key `mlb.theme`, frontend/src/theme.ts pure guarded readStoredTheme/storeTheme + resolveTheme, frontend/src/ThemeContext.tsx provider, ThemeToggle component). MIRROR this for favorites: a PURE module frontend/src/favorites.ts (localStorage key `mlb.favorites` holding a JSON array of team ids, guarded read/write + add/remove/toggle, ignore corrupt values) with unit tests, and a React glue frontend/src/FavoritesContext.tsx provider + useFavorites() hook, wired in frontend/src/main.tsx alongside ThemeProvider/I18nProvider. PURE BRACKET HELPERS belong in frontend/src/bracketLayout.ts (which already exports buildRoundColumns, seriesLeaderId, clinchWins) or a sibling pure module; add findTeamSeries(bracket, teamId), isTeamEliminated(bracket, teamId), favoriteSummary(bracket, teamId) with unit tests over fixture brackets. i18n: ALL new strings go in frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts (add MessageKey union entries + both en and ja values; default lang is ja). Team identity: TEAMS map in @mlb/shared (id -> {name, abbreviation, league}); teamName(t, id)/teamAbbr(t, id) helpers; TeamBadge.tsx renders the color disc; teamColors.ts + readableTextColor.ts for AA contrast; dark mode via <html data-theme>. SeriesCard keyboard model (#22): the <article> holds a roving tabindex and an onKeyDown that BAILS OUT when event.target !== event.currentTarget (so inner buttons keep native behavior) - any new inner star button must sit inside the card and will be ignored by the card handler automatically; preserve this. clinchWins(bestOf) = floor(bestOf/2)+1 determines series winner; a team is eliminated if it is in a status==='final' series and its wins < clinchWins (it lost). computeStandings() in StandingsPanel.tsx already derives eliminated/champion per team - reuse its logic shape for consistency.
